hints.title: Simulate
hints.body: Compute the sum of squared digits and repeat from the new value.

hints.title: A cycle means no
hints.body: If a value repeats before reaching `1`, the process is trapped and will never reach `1`.

hints.title: Remember seen values
hints.body: Use a set of previously visited values, or Floyd slow/fast pointers, to detect repetition.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
seen = empty set
current = value
while current != 1 and current not in seen:
    add current to seen
    total = 0
    while current > 0:
        digit = current % 10
        total += digit * digit
        current = current // 10
    current = total
return current == 1
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
